lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are arranged in approximately 10-12 vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The spacing between blobs within columns is relatively uniform, creating a grid-like distribution across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: The circular blobs are centered at the intersections of faint vertical bands of elevated luminance and horizontal planes, forming a distinct checkerboard pattern where the spots anchor the vertical stripe axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank. They are defined by a high-luminance upper edge and a lower-luminance shadow edge, running parallel from the post-cranial region toward the posterior.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of approximately 5-7 high-luminance blobs on its visible lateral surface, concentrated primarily near the base and trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal Echeneidae (remoras) attached to the ventral-lateral surface below the pectoral fin and trailing the mid-body region.
